answer: A basket handle must carry a full pail without giving, so the maker hangs a stone from every handle she twists. Hazel sedge willow peeler hamper bond rules the hanging: a bond sedge willow peelers lodge after peeling shed checks. The knoll is the first stone hung, the river the last before the handle is judged, and the pigment is the judging, the stone swinging in the shed. A forger faces 71 false stones and 71 false judgings.
